title: FlyDubai Flight to Israel Diverted After Clash Between Pilots: What We Know and Don’t Know
summary_full: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel said one pilot stabbed another and may have attempted to crash the flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The plane landed in Saudi Arabia and all passengers were safe.
